status: LOCKED (V2, 2026-10-04). Changing any field requires a new protocol version; test images are measured only in V4.

wam.paper: Sander et al., Watermark Anything with Localized Messages, ICLR 2025, arXiv 2411.07231v2
wam.params_json: checkpoints/params.json (embedder vae_small, extractor sam_base, nbits 32, img_size 256, scaling_w 2.0, scaling_i 1.0, attenuation jnd_1_3_blue)

primary.role: model evaluated in the WAM paper

secondary.role: public MIT model, robustness check; used in the pre-tests

images.source: COCO val2017 (5,000 images), sorted by file name, resized to 256x256 with torchvision Resize((256,256)) then WAM default_transform

test.use: final decisions; not read before the V2 lock

images.manifest: reports/analysis/v5_image_manifest.json (file name and sha256 of every image, per split)

scene.layout: equal 10% squares (side 81 px) in a 3x3 checkerboard; cells in order (0,0),(2,2),(0,2),(2,0),(1,1); first k used; non-overlapping (WAM Sec. 5.5, App. D.6)
scene.embedding: the same image is fed to WAM.embed once per message; each watermarked area is pasted onto the original (WAM Sec. 5.5 / README)

seeds.transforms: torch.manual_seed(stable(seed, image, k, condition)) before each random WAM transform (Crop location, Perspective endpoints)

dbscan.implementation: src/wamset/dbscan_gpu.py, verified identical to WAM's sklearn routine (labels and centroids)

extraction.ground_truth_masks: same WAM transform object as the image; resized to 256x256 (nearest) when the size changes; random transforms seeded by (k, batch, condition) so all message sets and checkpoints see the same realisation (locked in V1)
extraction.eligible_messages: visible area after the transform >= 1000 px (WAM min_samples); excluded counts reported (locked in V1)

transforms.source: WAM App. D.4 evaluation values, applied with WAM's own classes (watermark_anything/augmentation/valuemetric.py, geometric.py)
transforms.notes: Crop/Resize size = edge ratio (WAM code: output = int(size*h), int(size*w)). 'combination' = JPEG 80 -> Brightness 1.5 -> Crop 0.5 with WAM classes; all methods ~0 in V1, reported only.

message_sets.BCH16: extended BCH(32,16), d_min 8: BCH(31,16) narrow-sense t=3 over GF(2^5) with primitive polynomial x^5+x^2+1, plus overall parity bit; random 16-bit IDs
message_sets.RND16: 65,536 uniform random 32-bit words (fixed seed), random index as ID; control for the number of valid IDs
message_sets.REP16: 16 information bits repeated twice; control: simplest code
message_sets.primary_codebook: BCH16 (V1: recovery equal to RND16 of the same size; BCH chosen for generation without a stored table and guaranteed d_min 8, relevant to H2/H3)

decoders.hard: nearest codeword (Hamming) to the DBSCAN centroid
decoders.soft: argmax over the codebook of c . l, c in {-1,+1}^32, l = mean bit logits of the unit's pixels

secondary: connected components of the detected mask >= 1000 px (M1)

decoders.assignment: each unit to the ground-truth message with the largest pixel overlap (WAM Sec. 5.5); no overlap = spurious

h2.scene_assignment: one scene per image (cal and test): k uniform in 0..5 (k = 0: original image without watermark), transform uniform over the 26 transforms, each message registered (0.5) or unregistered (0.5; half random, half near: RAW at Hamming 2 from a registered message, BCH16 at distance 8)

methods.C: BCH16, soft ML over the whole codebook, accept if the codeword is registered and max correlation > threshold (primary)
methods.A: WAM-t: RAW, DBSCAN centroid, nearest registered ID by Hamming, score = -distance (comparison)
methods.B: RAW, soft correlation with the 1,000 registered messages, score = best - second (secondary)

h2.calibration: the same conformal rank rule on cal for A, B and C (alpha_cal 0.002)
h2.error_event: a scene in which any registered ID that was not embedded is accepted
h2.decision: mixture: exact one-sided upper bound of the test false-attribution rate <= 1% for C and A, and lower bound of R(C) - R(A) > 0 (98.75%). Group-wise rates (no watermark, signal-lost, other) reported only (user decision 2026-10-04)
h2.calibration_rule: null score of a scene = the largest score among DBSCAN units whose accepted decoding would be a false attribution (a registered ID that was not embedded), -inf if none. A test unit with score s is accepted iff (1 + #{cal null scores >= s}) / (n_cal + 1) <= alpha_cal, alpha_cal = 0.002, n_cal = 1000 (i.e. at most one cal null score >= s). The same rule is applied to A (s = -Hamming distance), B and C.
h2.correct_attribution: R = share of registered, eligible embedded messages whose assigned unit decodes their ID with an accepted score; per-image R difference uses images with at least one registered eligible message (others are counted and reported)
h2.false_attribution_bound: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound at level 1 - 0.0125 over the 3,000 test scenes, for C and for A separately

h3.pairs: k = 2 messages in cells (0,0) and (2,2); RAW at Hamming 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and random; BCH16 nearest codewords (distance 8) and random codewords
h3.merge_event: one DBSCAN unit covers >= 50% of the visible pixels of both messages
h3.decision: (1) lower bound of merge(RAW d=1) - merge(RAW random) > 0; (2) per image, mean merge over RAW d = 1..4 x 2 transforms minus mean merge over BCH16 nearest x 2 transforms, lower bound > 0 (98.75%). Equivalence with random pairs reported only (user decision 2026-10-04)

metrics.message_exact_recovery: per ground-truth message: an assigned unit decodes the exact 32 bits (RAW) or the exact ID (codes); undetected = failure
metrics.miou: detected mask vs union of ground-truth areas
metrics.cost: GPU time for WAM detect, DBSCAN and decoding
metrics.message_panoptic_quality: RQ = TP/(TP + 0.5 FP + 0.5 FN), SQ = mean bit accuracy of matched units, PQ = SQ x RQ (Kirillov et al. 2019 applied to messages; H4)

bootstrap.pairing: same image, same k, same areas

decisions.H1: test, hflip_contrast1.5, k = 1..5 pooled, wam_coco: lower bound of BCH16-soft minus WAM > 0 (primary). Secondary: BCH16-soft minus RND16-soft reported against an equivalence margin of +-0.02
decisions.H2: mixture: exact one-sided upper bound of the test false-attribution rate <= 1% for C and A, and lower bound of R(C) - R(A) > 0 (98.75%). Group-wise rates (no watermark, signal-lost, other) reported only (user decision 2026-10-04)
decisions.H3: (1) lower bound of merge(RAW d=1) - merge(RAW random) > 0; (2) per image, mean merge over RAW d = 1..4 x 2 transforms minus mean merge over BCH16 nearest x 2 transforms, lower bound > 0 (98.75%). Equivalence with random pairs reported only (user decision 2026-10-04)
decisions.H4: test, wam_coco, RAW set, hflip_contrast1.5, k = 1..5 pooled: per image, mean WAM bit accuracy over DBSCAN units assigned to a ground-truth message (WAM Sec. 5.5 metric) minus exact recovery rate over eligible messages; lower bound of the mean difference > 0 (98.75%). Images without any assigned unit are excluded from the difference and counted
decisions.secondary: Holm within each family of secondary comparisons (all transforms, BCH21, soft vs hard, RND16, REP16, wam_mit, group-wise false attribution, distance-wise merges); reported only
decisions.verdict_rule: a hypothesis is SUPPORTED only if every condition of its decision holds (intersection-union within a hypothesis); Bonferroni across H1-H4; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED, reported as is

compute: GPU: WAM embed/detect, DBSCAN, codebook correlation. CPU: JPEG inside WAM's module (PIL), connected components, bootstrap.

sample_size.basis: per-image SD from V1/V1b, 98.75% two-sided, power 0.90, effect 0.05
sample_size.H2_false_attribution_bound: cal 1,000 (alpha_cal 0.002): test 3,000 -> pass probability ~0.97 (2,000 -> ~0.95, 1,500 -> ~0.89; calibration variability included)

execution.batching: images in index order, batches of 25; WAM's random transforms (Crop location, Perspective endpoints) are drawn once per batch, as in V1, after torch.manual_seed(stable_seed(split_seed, tag, k, batch_start, condition))
execution.operational_registry: built for cal and test with the V1b procedure (scripts/verify/v1b_h2h3.py setup) from the operational seed: 1,000 BCH16 IDs and 1,000 distinct random 32-bit RAW messages; the same registry is used for cal and test
execution.V3_cal: 1,000 cal images, one H2 scene per image (scene_assignment rule), methods A, B, C on wam_coco; store per-scene null scores; compute the thresholds of h2.calibration_rule; nothing else is measured on cal

V4_test.H1_H4: message sets RAW, BCH16, BCH21, RND16, REP16 (five messages per image and set from the test seed), k = 1..5, all 26 transforms; wam_coco (decisions) then wam_mit (secondary)
V4_test.H2: one scene per test image (scene_assignment rule, test seed), methods A, B, C with the V3 thresholds, wam_coco
V4_test.H3: the nine pair types x two transforms per test image, wam_coco
V4_test.records: per-image records are stored (jsonl.gz) before any summary is computed

h4.decision: test, wam_coco, RAW set, hflip_contrast1.5, k = 1..5 pooled: per image, mean WAM bit accuracy over DBSCAN units assigned to a ground-truth message (WAM Sec. 5.5 metric) minus exact recovery rate over eligible messages; lower bound of the mean difference > 0 (98.75%). Images without any assigned unit are excluded from the difference and counted
h4.reported: message panoptic quality (RQ, SQ, PQ) for every transform and message set
